name: version-00
about: The header as the W3C trace context writes it. Both ids are carried through unchanged and the flags byte is carried as written.

name: unsampled-flags
about: `trace-flags` is carried, not interpreted: a caller that did not sample its own trace still names the trace this export joins.

name: later-version-with-extra-fields
about: The forward compatibility the specification asks of a parser: a version after `00` may append fields, and the four this parser knows are read out of it anyway.

name: surrounding-whitespace
about: A header value a proxy padded. The framing is not the caller's trace, so it is trimmed rather than refused.

name: no-header-at-all
about: The commonest case by far: nobody traced into this execution, and the export derives a trace id of its own.

name: three-fields
about: A header cut short. Four fields are the floor of every version.

name: empty-header
about: A header present and blank — what a client that set the name and forgot the value sends.

name: version-not-hex
about: A version that is not two hex digits is not a version this or any later specification defines.

name: version-ff-is-reserved
about: `ff` is reserved by the specification and must never be accepted — the one version that is refused despite being well formed.

name: version-00-with-a-fifth-field
about: Version `00` is exactly four fields. A fifth is a header written against a version its own version byte does not claim.

name: trace-id-uppercase
about: The specification's hex is lowercase. An uppercase id is not the same string to a collector, so it is refused rather than folded.

name: trace-id-too-short
about: Thirty-one hex characters: a trace id of the wrong width is not a trace id.

name: trace-id-all-zero
about: The invalid trace id the specification names outright. Adopting it would publish every span under an id a collector drops.

name: span-id-not-hex
about: A parent id with a character outside `[0-9a-f]`.

name: span-id-too-short
about: Fifteen hex characters, which is a parent id nothing can be parented at.

name: span-id-all-zero
about: The invalid parent id the specification names. A root parented at it is a root parented at nothing, said the wrong way.

name: flags-not-hex
about: Two characters that are not two hex digits.

name: trailing-dash
about: A header that ended on its separator. It has four fields and the last of them is empty, which is a `trace-flags` that is not two hex digits rather than a field that is absent.
